en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a tall lattice radio mast or transmission tower rising above a snowy landscape. Conifer trees with snow on their branches frame the foreground. At the base of the mast there is a low industrial building complex and other smaller structures. The word "Lahti" is printed in the lower left corner, and there are handwritten numbers in the upper right margin.
